title: Establish permanent player CI and behavioral protection
purpose: Protect the promoted RC715 standalone baseline with permanent clean-build, contract, browser, persistence, recovery, and representative black-box regression gates before any architectural seam is implemented.

baseline.selectionRule: Begin from the promoted RC715 source and preserve its externally observable behavior unless an explicit functional change is separately approved. The permanent gate is installed against the current compatible RC718 continuation tree without modifying player runtime source.

invariants: No player runtime behavior is changed by this work package.
Every CI result is tied to an exact commit and clean checkout.
The reviewed source produces the tested artifact.
Representative black-box fixtures cover the promoted baseline's critical user and data journeys.
Browser tests are split into reliable bounded jobs rather than one fragile monolithic runner.
Failure evidence is retained long enough for diagnosis without committing generated artifacts to source control.
The browser matrix is generated from the canonical checks registry and rejects missing, stale or duplicate suites.
Every browser job consumes the same build-once artifact and verifies its identity before and after execution.
requiredEvidence: clean player build in GitHub Actions
browser suite matrix with explicit suite inventory
persistence, restart, rename, import-export, and recovery coverage
workflow artifact or log retention policy
adversarialTests: mutate source after build and prove artifact identity gate fails
remove a required browser suite and prove suite-inventory validation fails
introduce an undeclared generated or archive file and prove repository validation fails
simulate interrupted persistence or import and verify recovery behavior
run browser jobs independently to prove one hung suite cannot hide the status of the others
mutate the built artifact and prove every consuming browser job rejects it
independentReview: human review only for any newly discovered interaction discrepancy

implementation.browserExecutionModel: one independent matrix job per declared browser suite

rollback: Revert the CI and test-only implementation commit. The promoted RC715 source and artifact and the RC718 runtime remain unchanged.
